# Lexonia Group

> Lexonia Group LLC (Eden Prairie, Minnesota) helps local service businesses in the US and Canada with social media marketing, lead generation and AI automation, managed for you or automated.

This file lists the pages that describe the business. It follows the site as published; it is updated when the site changes.

## Services
- [Services](https://lexoniagroup.com/services): positioning and strategy, social media marketing, social media lead generation, and AI automation.
- [About](https://lexoniagroup.com/about): who we are and how we work.
- [Contact](https://lexoniagroup.com/contact): book a free call.
- [Social Media](https://lexoniagroup.com/services/social-media): managed for you or automated from your own material; every post checked and approved by you; Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn.
- [Lead Generation](https://lexoniagroup.com/services/lead-generation): Meta campaigns on your positioning with form, booking and follow-up; listeners that send public “can anyone recommend” questions to your phone.
- [AI Automation](https://lexoniagroup.com/services/ai-automation): an assistant that does one job in your voice inside your rules; lead routing, booking, follow-up, reporting; never touches money.
- [AI Apps](https://lexoniagroup.com/services/ai-apps): apps we build on the Apify marketplace for Claude, ChatGPT and AI agents: Video Lens (transcribe and translate videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook Reels, Bilibili, Douyin, Vimeo), Audience Intel (the YouTubers and opinion leaders an audience watches, with contacts), Business Finder (the businesses of one kind in a city, state or region, with contacts).

## Blog
- [Can My AI Assistant Find Customers for Me?](https://lexoniagroup.com/blog/ai-assistant-find-customers): Connect an app and your AI assistant can list the businesses you sell to and find the YouTubers your customers watch. Two jobs, what to type, what comes back.
- [Why Does a Small Business’s Social Media Go Quiet When the Owner Gets Busy?](https://lexoniagroup.com/blog/social-media-goes-quiet): Because every post, reply and follow-up waits for one person. What can move to a system you approve from your phone, what should stay with the owner, and a five-minute checklist to start.
- [What Should Be My Monthly Meta Ad Budget?](https://lexoniagroup.com/blog/meta-ad-budget): The question most local businesses ask — and the question they should be asking instead. A practical look at Meta ad budgets, daily spend, and why lifetime value changes everything.
- [Building Social Trust: How Local Businesses Turn Followers Into Customers](https://lexoniagroup.com/blog/social-trust): Most businesses focus only on getting the booking. But trust is built long before someone reaches out. Here's the 6-stage Trust Ladder every local business needs to understand.
- [Why Most Local Business Ads Don't Convert — And What to Do Instead](https://lexoniagroup.com/blog/why-local-ads-fail): Running ads before locking your positioning is the most expensive mistake local businesses make. Here's why it happens and the one fix that changes everything.
